info.title: ProctorNet API Specification
info.description:
Authoritative machine-readable OpenAPI 3.1 specification for ProctorNet Modular Monolith examination, proctoring, and evaluation platform.

Covers 100% of REST routes across all five system roles: ADMIN, DEVELOPER, FACULTY, INVIGILATOR, STUDENT.

tags.name: Authentication & Session
tags.description: Dual-JWT authentication, token rotation, and account security

tags.name: User Administration
tags.description: User provisioning, roster management, and institutional settings (ADMIN)

tags.name: Candidate Identity
tags.description: Identity profile onboarding, USN, and document upload (STUDENT, ADMIN)

tags.name: Biometrics & Anti-Spoofing
tags.description: Face enrollment, 128D embedding extraction, and liveness challenges

tags.name: Question Bank
tags.description: Question authoring, cloning, and topic classification (FACULTY, ADMIN)

tags.name: Exams & Blueprints
tags.description: Exam lifecycle, blueprint topic rules, and publication (FACULTY, ADMIN)

tags.name: Sessions & Scheduling
tags.description: Room scheduling, student rosters, and invigilator assignment

tags.name: Attempts & Taking
tags.description: Deterministic question mapping, exam start, and attempt lifecycle (STUDENT)

tags.name: Answers & Autosave
tags.description: Revision-tracked answer saves, batch autosave, and submission idempotency

tags.name: Results & Manual Grading
tags.description: Objective scoring, subjective grading rubrics, and grade publication
